Two older files in the same folder ('...DMC rates 2026-2027.pdf' and '...rates 2026-2027.pdf') were NOT extracted - this newer 2027-2028 document supersedes them for our slice.
note: Camp closed 18 April - 12 May 2028 (outside this validity window's start but relevant if quoting into 2028)

rates.unit: per person per night unless noted; Family Tent priced per unit
rates.confidenceNote: DMC rate is roughly 75% of Rack on most cells (e.g. Game Package Peak Sharing 730->548 = 75.07%) but not an exact clean 25% on every cell - treat as the contracted DMC figure itself rather than a derived percentage.

mandatoryFees.amboseliParkFees: Paid directly to KWS by agent/guest - not a fixed figure in this document

elephantGardenConservancyFee.note: Only applicable to Game Package, not Full Board

specialOffers.pay3Stay4: 25% discount on accommodation for a 4-night stay charged as 3; excludes Jul-Sep; park/conservancy fees still charged for all nights
specialOffers.singleDiscount: First single tent in a booking charged at double-sharing rate (Full Board only, not Game Package); excludes Jul-Sep
specialOffers.honeymoonDiscount: 25% off accommodation for one partner; valid all seasons; requires marriage certificate, travel within 9 months of wedding

childPolicy.under8SharingWith1or2Adults: Free of charge (in addition to adult single/double rate)
childPolicy.age8to17SharingWith1or2Adults: 50% of adult rate (in addition to adult single/double rate)

occupancy.thirdGuestInStandardTent: 50% of double sharing rate (adult or child 8-17)

tourLeaderRates.unit: per person sharing, includes meals and soft drinks

cancellationPolicy: After confirmation: 20%; 45-30 days before arrival: 50%; less than 30 days/no-show: 100%
singleTentPolicy: 3 or fewer single tents per booking = single tent rate; 4th+ single tent charged at double-tent rate (2x double sharing)
